titles.title: Autumn Tree

description: Blazing orange, red, and yellow foliage clings to the brown limbs of a large tree. The clusters of leaves appear to swallow up smaller green trees like a burning forest fire. The bright scene contrasts with patches of blue sky overhead.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
